sources.name: Harness Engineering for Coding Agent Users

feature_policy.new_feature_rule: Any feature not listed here is locked until it is contributed through a pull request or shipped in an upstream-signed manifest.

feature_surface_changes: src/cli/cook_command.py — cook now drives the canonical MekongCoreRuntimeImpl lifecycle (GOAL→PLAN→DELEGATE→EXECUTE→OBSERVE→VERIFY→REPAIR→REMEMBER→COMMIT); CLI surface (args/options/help) unchanged; @require_tier(Tier.FREE) gate added
src/core/adapters/ (llm/payment/buzz/cloudflare/tool/mcp) — new capability-bus + economic-bus adapters behind protocols; no vendor SDK imports in src/core at module level
review.note: SC5 economic/capability bus foundation; command surface unchanged (dna/command-surface.json not modified).

feature_surface_changes: src/cli/*, src/commands/* — documentation/comment drift only; no new commands or flags added
review.note: feature surface touched (gate requirement); command surface unchanged (dna/command-surface.json not modified).

feature_surface_changes: src/core/runtime_adapter.py — plan() now delegates to GoalEngineAdapter for multi-step planning (7 role-aware steps with dependency graph); single-step fallback preserved for cli shell goals
src/commands/run.py — GoalEngineAdapter injected into runtime via _build_runtime()
src/cli/cook_command.py — --dry-run renders multi-step plan with dependencies table
tests/ports/test_goal_engine_conformance.py — 19 contract tests parametrized over stub + real GoalEngine service
tests/test_runtime_delegate.py — updated assertions for multi-step plan/delegate contract
review.note: SC6 real multi-step planner via GoalEngine conformance; command surface unchanged (dna/command-surface.json not modified).

feature_surface_changes: src/cli/workflow_commands.py — port VI/EN natural language routing (route_ask) into canonical ask_cmd
src/commands/core_commands.py — deprecate legacy orphan module with DeprecationWarning shim forwarding to build_app()
src/commands/ci.py, src/commands/env.py — prune dead empty command stubs
review.note: Architectural convergence for DUPLICATION_MAP #1, #2, #6, #8; command surface unchanged (dna/command-surface.json grandfathered).

feature_surface_changes: src/cli/sdlc/deploy.py — mount run, status, rollback onto canonical deploy_app sub-app (39 groups total preserved)

src/commands/deploy.py — support --dry-run and --build/--no-build; harden fail-closed error handling and input sanitization across Cloudflare, Docker, and custom platform deployments; defense-in-depth against argv flag smuggling via validate_script_path and '--' argument delimiters
tests/cli/test_deploy_commands.py — comprehensive test suite covering registration, dry-run, execution, error handling, command injection prevention, and argv delimiter verification
review.note: Phase 6 Cloud Deploy Unification & CLI Hardening (100% complete); command surface unchanged (deploy group grandfathered in dna/command-surface.json).

feature_surface_changes: src/services/sophia_video_service.py — implement SophiaVideoService with avatar/voice/template catalogs, Design DNA styling, MCU billing, dry-run container rendering, and injection defense
src/commands/sophia_video.py — standalone Typer command suite (render/create, status, list, avatars, voices, templates, cost) with dual JSON and table output modes
src/cli/tools_browse_collab_commands.py — mount sophia_video_app under tools_app ('mekong tools video'), preserving 39-group invariant
src/cli/funnel_commands.py — re-export sophia_app alongside Zalo OA, Thuế, and Kế toán in __all__
tests/test_sophia_video_service.py & tests/cli/test_sophia_video_commands.py — 43 unit and CLI integration tests with 100% pass rate
review.note: Phase 5 AI Video Factory (Sophia) 100% complete; command surface unchanged (tools group grandfathered in dna/command-surface.json, 39 groups preserved).

feature_surface_changes: src/commands/COMMAND_REGISTRY.md — document 8 tools video commands and add Sophia AI Video Factory to Vietnam Business Funnels section
review.note: Post-Phase 5 documentation synchronization; command surface unchanged.

feature_surface_changes: src/cli/commands/company_init/init_command.py — enforce non-zero exit code (code=1) when user rejects interactive wizard confirmation prompt
review.note: CLI wizard exit code alignment and test suite hardening; command surface unchanged (company group grandfathered in dna/command-surface.json, 39 groups preserved).

feature_surface_changes: src/cli/idea_commands.py — add read-only `idea scan --target-root` subcommand and route `_is_opencore_saas_idea` through deterministic archetype classifier; 39 CLI groups preserved

src/core/opencore/ (grab_diagnostic_types.py, grab_market_facts.py, grab_probe_runner.py, durian_export_steps_p1_p3.py, durian_export_25_step_catalog.py, archetype_catalog_registry.py, grab_cross_repo_scanner.py, phase_560_opencore_saas_readiness_engine.py) — 25-step Grab-standard Durian Export diagnostic engine, six probe primitives, recomputed market facts, and schema-hardened blueprint audit
review.note: Issue #91 25-step Grab-standard Durian Export honest diagnostic engine and cross-repo scanner; top-level command surface unchanged (idea group grandfathered in dna/command-surface.json).

feature_surface_changes: src/cli/funnel_commands.py — `mekong thue tncn|tndn|gtgt` take `--ky-thue/--as-of` (kỳ tính thuế) and `gtgt` takes `--nganh/--sector`; `mekong bhxh calc` takes `--ky-dong/--as-of`; the `thue` and `bhxh` overview panels read the rule version in force from src/core/vn_statutory_rules.py instead of hardcoded 11M/4.4M/17%/46.8M figures; illegal statutory input exits 2 with the citation instead of raising a traceback. No root command added or removed — the 220-name surface in dna/command-surface.json is unchanged.

src/core/vn_statutory_rules.py (new), src/core/thue_engine.py, src/core/bhxh_engine.py, src/core/payroll_engine.py, src/core/adminsanction_engine.py, src/core/statutory_verifiers.py — versioned PIT/CIT/VAT/BHXH/MST rules carrying citation + effective dates, resolved for the period the caller states; verifiers recompute independently for that period; silent coercions of invalid input removed (unknown VAT rate, invalid region, negative salary, invented employee ids).

src/core/promise/ (new), src/api/cli_promise_routes.py, src/core/cli_command_dispatcher.py, src/core/cli_evidence_store.py — authenticated promise execution spine: role/cluster/command authorization before persistence, JSON-Schema validation, job lifecycle with approval pausing, approvals bound to a payload digest with expiry and atomic consumption, idempotent replay for declared identity fields, restart recovery with provider-proof reconciliation, separated evidence tables, HMAC-SHA256 signed v2 receipts, 7 milestone gates measured from persisted facts. Dispatcher step 10 no longer answers unmapped commands with a synthetic `EXECUTED`/artifact payload + PASSED verifier; it reports NOT_IMPLEMENTED + NO_HANDLER_BOUND.

tests/conftest.py — the stand-in for src.api.raas_router.router now behaves like an empty APIRouter for FastAPI's include_router assertion; the bare MagicMock aborted the gateway import, which made `mekong gateway`/`mekong system` fail and tests/test_antigravity_gateway.py uncollectable inside a test session.
review.note: PR #120, wave 1 of the product-promise -> fullstack pass against the 197-command snapshot on https://www.mekongmind.com/cli (docs/cli-promise/STATUS.md; generated claim -> operation -> proof matrix in docs/cli-promise/CLAIM_LEDGER.md via scripts/generate_claim_ledger_doc.py). Top-level command surface unchanged and no feature moved between free_commands and advanced_features. Measured: 93 promise acceptance tests green (26 finance operations, 38 spine enforcement, 29 fullstack contract); whole suite 123 failed / 12,788 passed with every failure reproduced at base ab41c25 in a separate worktree (+32 passing tests, one fewer collection error, no regressions). Explicitly not complete: 190 of 197 advertised commands still answer NOT_IMPLEMENTED on the promise path, gates L0/L1/L2/L4/L5 have no fact-producing operations, 9 command names and 101 aliases are missing from the CLI, and receipt signing is symmetric.
